_note: The three Baidu downloads were Veer stock-agency photographs (licensing untraceable). The kept photo is the terminal's name board from the Ethiopian News Agency's report on the June 2024 reopening; a duplicate of it and an officials-on-tour photograph were left out.

axu-page-1.webp.zh: 阿克苏姆机场航站楼正面的名称标牌：阿姆哈拉语与英文「AXUM YOHANNES IV AIRPORT」并排，上方是埃塞俄比亚航空的标志（2024 年修复通航后拍摄）。
axu-page-1.webp.en: The name board on Axum airport's terminal — Amharic alongside 'AXUM YOHANNES IV AIRPORT', the Ethiopian Airlines mark above (photographed after the 2024 reopening).
